Page 174 Cont.
Dec. 13 Stanley Kalmskes - 29 - pneum.
Sharon Penn - 23 m. - normal ... wonderful (see Nov. 15th Child re- covering) Drs. and nurses all astonished.
Dec. 13th Dolores Weber - 62 - presure on brain-cell. Drs. give no hope of recovery .... Enrolled To-night
15 Mr. & Mrs. Herbaut - Elderly Couple - she has Cancer and Heart- trouble
Page 175
Dec. 18 Betty Daehiell from Dearborne - 20 - Community art - a stroke in January 1911 - then had operation for brain tuomer - NOW - unable to raise right arm or walk without help .....
19 James Brown of Seattle Wash. - 73 - gangreenous foot - los of leg feared. His sister here asks for prayers ... Enrolling him To-day, perpetual M.
2:15 P.M. - Lol Stewart - 14 months - Episcopelian baby. operation on brain tuomer .... Enrolled To-day for year ... Spinal maningit .... 7:15 p.m. Parents here To-night - 8 oz. of fluid taken from brain a.m. instead of 12 oz. - Hopeless ... Better To-night
2: 15 P.M. Elzear Poisson - 38 - Operated for tuomer on brain a week yesterday. . . hopes to escape further operation. Enrolled To-day per- petually ...
20 Arthur Meteyer - 38 - has wife and little boy - operated on ten days ago for pentecitis and gall-bl. trouble - was doing well, but yester- day took fit of coughing and then torr the incision open ... is in bad shape - Enrolled again this A.M.
Mrs. M. Johnson - 55 - internal cancer - "hopeless".
Page 176
Andrew Borland - 41 - with family .... In doubt what should be done .... Andrew Kronner - 71 - of Richmond Mich. - cured of cancer and blind- ness a year ago, now paralysis ....
Alfred Casterton - 70 - New Years Day Bronica. ..
